records.scope_notes: Social studies of science and technology, including research institutions, knowledge production and research practices; a substantive STS contribution is necessary.

route.conditions: Journal instructions state no submission or publication fees. Optional Sage Choice OA costs extra; confirm any optional production charges.

records.name: Science Communication
records.scope_notes: Research on communication of scientific knowledge and relationships among science, media and publics; analysis of existing communication data may fit.

route.conditions: Journal instructions state no submission or publication fees. Optional Sage Choice OA costs extra; requested print colour may be charged. Instructions also mention page or colour charges without specifying when page charges apply; verify.

records.name: Information Services and Use
records.scope_notes: Scholarly communication, information services and research information infrastructure; research on open science and publishing systems can fit.

route.conditions: Instructions say no submission or publication fees; open-access S2O text explicitly describes 2024 only, so current model and compulsory extras require verification.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown; current S2O period needs checking.

fee_evidence.note: Journal instructions say there are no fees payable to submit or publish; its S2O explanation is limited to 2024.

notes: All four journal instructions link Sage AI guidance. Sage permits disclosed generated text, literature assistance and AI-generated research code, subject to human verification; it prohibits generated data and analysis of experiences and themes. AI role must assess applicability and specific restrictions independently.

Information Services and Use lists no submission or publication fees but its S2O explanation specifies 2024; present open-access funding model requires verification. Science Communication instructions mention page charges without explaining applicability despite no-fee statement; fee review required.
Science, Technology, & Human Values appears elsewhere in the global baseline; this is an additional field membership, not a new venue identity.

Excluded Taylor & Francis candidates because publisher policy prohibits first drafts of manuscripts or sections: https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/editorial-policies/using-ai-in-your-research-and-manuscript-preparations/.
